summary: Read two texts, a source named S and a target named T. Inside S, find one contiguous stretch that covers T. Covering means every character occurs in the stretch at least as many times as it occurs in T. Characters absent from T may still sit inside the stretch. Among stretches that cover T, write the shortest one. If any covering stretch exists, only one stretch has that shortest length. If no stretch covers T, write an empty text. Uppercase letters and lowercase letters count as different characters.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
